pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Needs 5 V for good contrast: use VIN

pins.name: SDA
pins.notes: The backpack pulls SDA up to 5 V. Usually works; a level shifter is safer

pins.name: SCL
pins.notes: The backpack pulls SCL up to 5 V. Usually works; a level shifter is safer

source.title: Orient Display OD-AMC1602A Series LCD module specification
source.section: 3. General Specification: module 80.0 x 36.0 x 14.0 (LED backlight), view area 64.5 x 15.5, active area 56.20 x 11.50, character 2.95 x 5.55, dot 0.55 x 0.65, pitch 0.60 x 0.70 mm

gotchas.text: The backpack answers at 0x27 (PCF8574) or 0x3F (PCF8574A). If nothing shows up at 0x27, try 0x3F.
Blank screen or only blocks? Turn the contrast potentiometer on the back.

sources.title: NXP PCF8574 / PCF8574A datasheet
sources.section: Address 0x20 to 0x27 (PCF8574T) or 0x38 to 0x3F (PCF8574AT) via A0-A2; most backpacks ship as 0x27 or 0x3F

sources.title: Hitachi HD44780U datasheet
